motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable decorative motion when requested by the user.

narrative.overview: 页面像一个晚上仍亮着灯的工程工作台：信息可靠、路径清楚，边角留有一点像素羊带来的轻松感。

rules.name: The Reading-First Rule
rules.body: 每个页面首先回答下一步读什么或做什么，再展示低频工具。

rules.name: The Evidence-Over-Decoration Rule
rules.body: 真实内容和可验证状态优先于装饰性数字和重复卡片。

dos: Do let the first meaningful action lead to a real article.
Do keep the pixel sheep visible as a quiet, discoverable signature.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard as the public homepage.
Don't let the pixel sheep, AI lab, achievements and random features compete with reading.
